meaning:
1) to come, arrive
1a) (Qal) to come (of men, time, beasts, calamity)
1b) (Hiphil) to bring
Aramaic equivalent: a.tah (אֲתָה "to come" H0858)

renderings.kjv: the things that are to come
and the things that are coming
